videos.script: Lucia opens her knee scan. The address ends in exams slash one. {{one}} She is signed in, the scan is hers, everything is right. Now change the one to a two. {{two}} If the portal answers with Marta's spine X-ray, it checked that somebody was signed in. It never checked whose exam it was. {{whose}} That is an insecure direct object reference. The request names a record, and the server believes the name. {{name}} The fix is not hiding the number. It is asking the database for exam two belonging to Lucia, and getting nothing. {{fix}} Today a test asks every patient for every exam, and only the owner gets an answer. {{today}}
